blurb: Ocean Fun Rentals offers pontoon boat and jet ski rentals in Madeira Beach, Florida, including captain-led or self-guided pontoon excursions and a guided Dolphin Jet Ski Tour. Guests can explore local waterways, sandbars, and islands, and may see dolphins, rays, and sea turtles. Reservations are recommended and deposits are required.
extraNote: Deposit required: $500 for pontoon boats, $250 per jet ski; refunded if no damages · Deposit does not limit responsibility for damages; full cost payable if damages exceed deposit · Late fee $100 per half hour if boat returned late · $60 cleaning fee if boat returned dirty · Reservations recommended; charges become 100% nonrefundable within 72 hours of rental time · Cancellations or changes allowed without charge for inclement weather with communication · Cambria Hotel Marina, 15015 Madeira Way Beach, Florida
